outcome: LDL-C, triglycerides, hsCRP, fasting glucose in adults
note: PMID 37296402 (9 studies, EO 500-1500 mg/day): LDL-C -15.08 mg/dL, VLDL -5.43, TG -22.35, hsCRP -1.70, with the authors' own caution about heterogeneity. PMID 36934568 (5 RCTs) agrees. A 500 mg/day floor is proposed because that is the lowest dose the syntheses cover; the catalog median is 120 mg, so most products would NOT qualify - that is the point of the floor. The branded AMX-160 RCT (40262554) supports but does not define the record and carries an erratum; the amla syrup alopecia trial (37487962) is off-axis and excluded.
